long_biography.plain_text:
James Merrill Cottrell belongs to the Virginia family behind Cottrell Contracting Corporation. The company traces its history to 1928 and has remained focused on dredging and marine construction along the eastern seaboard. His brother, Benjamin, led the business for three decades before his death in 2021.

Cottrell now serves as president and chief executive, directing a contractor whose work includes navigation channel maintenance, beach nourishment and environmental projects. He has represented the sector through the Dredging Contractors of America, including service as the association's president and later as a board vice president. That work places him at the intersection of heavy civil construction, waterway access and coastal resilience.
